scenes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 desktop website concept image, around 1920x1080, for Song He's interactive SUSTech personal resume. This is scene 01, the campus identity card hero. Art direction: precise architectural BLUEPRINT, saturated deep cobalt blue #073BC8 background, subtly darker at perimeter, entirely white fine drafting lines and tiny white anchor dots. Restrained aerospace document aesthetic, generous negative space, no black, no rainbow, no cyan/purple neon, no glassmorphism, no photographs, no astronaut illustrations. Faint sparse 48px drafting grid, a few crosshairs, modest edge ruler ticks. Flat web screenshot, no laptop mockup.
Layout: minimal tiny masthead 'SONG HE / PERSONAL ARCHIVE' top left; quiet navigation at top right '校园   科研   书院   经历'. Main object centered, about 50% viewport width, thin white horizontal campus-card perimeter of believable credit-card aspect ratio, viewed nearly face-on with a very subtle diagonal tilt. Its face is cobalt blue with a CLEAN TWO-DIMENSIONAL white architectural elevation drawing of a contemporary university campus spanning the lower half, not a raised model. Exact readable card text: '南方科技大学' and 'SUSTech' upper left, '校园卡' upper right, '宋和' and '2025 — 2029' discreet at bottom. This is an illustrative card, no fake real card ID number, no invented portrait or counterfeit insignia.
Two small ringed anchor dots on card's left/name region connect by THIN WHITE elbow leader lines to left margin annotations. Left large bold white '宋和', underneath monospaced 'SONG HE', then '2029 届本科' and smaller '预计毕业'. On the right a ringed campus anchor dot has a long thin elbow leader line leading to clear right-side white title '南方科技大学', with smaller '深圳 · 南山' and '双一流建设高校'. Below: tiny understated line 'QS / THE / ARWU / U.S. NEWS' and '世界大学排名 · 按年度标注' as a restrained metadata block; no numerical ranks. Annotations outside the card must be legible, never overlapping the object.
Bottom center: small vertical hairline, white dot, exact text '向下滚动，展开我的校园'. Tiny corner identifier '01 / IDENTITY'. Crisp high-fidelity Chinese typography, large surname title and elegant hierarchy. The visual should feel like a sophisticated actual web design, white vector drafting marks on BLUE paper, not a busy sci-fi dashboard. This is a visual concept, not a faithful depiction of the real campus card.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 desktop website concept image, around 1920x1080, scene 02 of Song He's SUSTech personal resume, after scrolling has transformed the campus card illustration into a spatial campus map. Consistent art direction: deep saturated royal cobalt #073BC8 architectural blueprint with WHITE fine edges, little white node dots, large quiet blue areas, faint thin square drafting grid, tiny restrained monospaced aerospace metadata. No cyan/purple, no neon glow, no black, no photography, no glass UI, no floating decorative cards, no astronauts.
Flat screenshot layout. Top left subtle masthead 'SONG HE / PERSONAL ARCHIVE'; top right text links '校园   科研   书院   经历'. Left upper heading in clear white Chinese '我的经历，发生在这里。', small subtitle '选择一个地点，进入对应的经历'.
Middle and lower 70% of viewport: a BEAUTIFUL ISOMETRIC architectural campus miniature raised out of a rectangular flat footprint, with the ghost-thin perimeter of the original campus card still beneath it. Use coherent invented concept massing of a southern Chinese contemporary hillside university, readable individual building volumes, airy white technical linework on blue faces; terraced land contour lines, a few trees shown as simple white dots, campus footpaths. Avoid opaque solid white masses. The 3D architecture should feel substantive and elegant, like a physical architecture model rendered as a drafting wireframe, not vague particles or circuitry. Academic cluster to viewer left, dormitory tower cluster back/right, student center near front/right. These are schematic positions, NOT a survey of the actual campus. Include tiny lower left note '空间布局为概念示意'.
EXACTLY THREE distinct callouts, beautifully composed outside the buildings, each connected to its building by a thin white leader line and a ringed dot, clean non-overlapping readable Chinese:
1 left annotation '01 科研经历' with smaller '工学院' and small '进入 →';
2 upper-right annotation '02 书院经历' with smaller '学生宿舍 15 栋' and small '进入 →';
3 lower-right annotation '03 校园经历' with smaller '学生中心' and small '进入 →'.
The engineering target can have slightly brighter and thicker white outline suggesting hover selection. All 3 locations reachable; no extra random labels. Tiny bottom-left '02 / CAMPUS'; bottom center small '点击地点，进入经历'. Strong whitespace, precise linework, minimal elegant aerospace archive website direction.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 desktop website concept image, around 1920x1080, scene 03 of Song He's SUSTech personal resume after clicking the engineering building and camera has arrived inside a visualization research lab. Art direction consistent with two other scenes: deep saturated cobalt blue #073BC8, ALL linework and type WHITE, sophisticated architectural BLUEPRINT and restrained astronaut mission-log typography, subtle sparse grid, exact crisp Chinese. Flat actual website screen, no monitor frame. No astronauts, planets, nebula, cyberpunk, glowing neon, glass cards, black backgrounds, fake achievements, charts that imply measured results.
Composition: immersive first-person/slightly diagonal white technical-line laboratory interior, depth extending toward back right. Right 55% shows desk rows, a workbench, simple thin-line display monitors containing ABSTRACT point clouds, 3D bounding-box diagrams and data visualization axes, white-outline architecture frames. Foreground desk corner low right and rear room frame imply having entered the building. Left 45% is calm blue negative space with just enough faint scene lines far behind copy for immersive continuity. White dots mark a few room corners.
Upper left small text '← 返回校园' and breadcrumb '校园 / 工学院 / 科研经历'. Top right tiny 'SONG HE / PERSONAL ARCHIVE'.
Left editorial text arranged like an astronaut field journal: tiny widely tracked mono 'RESEARCH LOG / 01', then HUGE BOLD WHITE Chinese title in two lines '马昱欣' on first and '实验室' on second. Underneath medium-weight '可视化方向', small uppercase 'VISUALIZATION RESEARCH'. A thin horizontal rule. Beneath it THREE short, restrained labeled document entries: '01 研究问题', '02 我的工作', '03 阶段产出'. Under each put small '内容待补充' so the image does not invent the person's research. Small quiet outlined/underlined link at lower left '查看研究记录 ↗'.
Bottom right a tiny campus overview minimap made only of simple white outlines with a bright node representing current room. Bottom edge tiny '03 / RESEARCH'. Typography bold and legible, whitespace, purposeful line-weight hierarchy. The laboratory is conceptual, not a documented actual room. This is the understated feeling of an aerospace expedition log crossed with a blueprint, no cluttered game HUD.
